hypothesis: Replacing the hard minimum over canonical configuration energies with a normalized entropic soft minimum can change the global potential geometry enough to repair the five residual taxi violations without the widespread regressions seen from local coefficient repairs.
rationale: The pinned seed has five exact taxi violations, all at depth zero with the same extension class, while coefficient and index-matrix perturbations were either globally destructive or circle-infeasible. Soft-min aggregation is a new global potential mechanism that changes all states coherently and can be screened on the complete 6006-edge circle instance before paying for taxi-scale evaluation.
expected_information_gain: A zero- or near-zero complete-circle score for a non-hard-min potential would identify a candidate family eligible for exact taxi evaluation; widespread circle violations would close this global aggregation family without spending taxi-scale compute. The screen is finite evidence only.
method: Use the unmodified pinned canonical configuration energies and evaluator inequality, but define candidate potential Phi_tau(w) = -tau log(mean_config exp(-E_config(w)/tau)) for positive temperatures tau, with the mean normalization preserving constant-shift behavior. Screen the hard-min control and temperatures 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, and 16 on every edge of circle_k4_m6.pickle. If any non-control variant has fewer than three circle violations, freeze its kwargs and run the exact pinned circle-taxi evaluator plus independent reproduction.
metric: complete pinned circle_k4_m6 violations_k across all 6006 edges, with taxi evaluation only for a promising non-control screen result
metric_relation_to_true_objective: The circle metric is a cheap finite proxy; only a lower violations_k count on the frozen circle_taxi_k4_m6 metric under the untouched evaluator is primary objective movement. Finite zero violations do not prove the full k-server conjecture.

configuration.aggregation: normalized entropic soft minimum over all canonical configuration energies

kill_condition: Stop after the complete 6006-edge screen, at the first non-control circle candidate with fewer than three violations for taxi escalation, or at a precise runtime failure. Do not taxi-score variants with widespread circle violations and do not claim conjecture proof from finite screening.
